generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course is about the work you are already doing. Every essay you write draws on reading, every report cites evidence, and every time you use someone else's idea you are expected to say where it came from. Treat what follows as being about your own assignments and reading, not about study in the abstract.

The same habit reaches past your degree. Wherever people build on the work of others, crediting your sources and evidencing your claims is what earns trust. Referencing well now is practice for that.
